the e-beam patterning of a BCP resist can be a viable approach for fabricating a chemical surface pattern to guide the assembly of a symmetric BCP blend.
it is possible to fabricate a surface chemical pattern with a feature size less than 70 nm using a one-component BCP resist, which is much smaller than the feature size of current e-beam lithography.
